premises.text: 600 million people live with diabetes, and 37% will develop diabetic retinopathy.
premises.evidence_span: 600 million live with diabetes. 37% will develop diabetic retinopathy, an eye condition that causes vision loss and blindness.

premises.text: Current treatments for diabetic retinopathy are complex, risky, and expensive.
premises.evidence_span: The available treatment is a $2,000 monthly injection of an antibody drug in the eye. This is complex, risky for the patient and expensive.

premises.text: Antibody drugs are a $200 billion market but are difficult to use and expensive.
premises.evidence_span: Antibody drugs are a $200 billion market and fundamental to treat diseases, but these are not easy to use or affordable.

premises.text: Monoclonal antibodies have significant challenges that limit their applications.
premises.evidence_span: Antibody drugs are made with monoclonal antibodies, which have significant challenges like their incapability to cross through most tissue barriers on the body, lack of stability out of cold chain and high manufacturing costs.

premises.text: Synthetic antibody mimetic proteins can replace monoclonal antibodies.
premises.evidence_span: designing synthetic antibody mimetic proteins to replace monoclonal antibodies and novel first-in-class therapeutics.

premises.text: The AMP platform can develop antibody drugs that have been impossible to develop.
premises.evidence_span: These advantages gives our AMP platform the ability to develop antibody drugs that have been impossible to develop, like antibody drugs in aerosol, in eye drops, viral delivery, or trans-termal release.

premises.text: AMPs can cross tissue barriers and generate limited immune reactions.
premises.evidence_span: Our AMP's can cross through tissue barriers, generate limited immune reactions even with no humanization.

premises.text: AMPs can target small and hard-to-reach antigens and are heat resistant.
premises.evidence_span: can target very small and hard to reach antigens, and are heat resistant.

premises.text: The company plans to outlicense AMPs to pharmaceutical companies for revenue.
premises.evidence_span: Then we outlicensed our AMP's to pharmaceutical companies, generating revenue from upfront payments, clinical phase and approval milestones, and then royalties over sales of the marketed products.

premises.text: The first AMP candidate is going into clinical phase next year.
premises.evidence_span: Our first AMP candidate, AMP1 for diabetic retinopathy, is going into clinical phase next year.

premises.text: AMP1 has shown proven capabilities for eye tissue penetration and therapeutic activity.
premises.evidence_span: Our AMP1 on in vivo testing shown proven capabilities for eye tissue penetration and therapeutic activity on the back of the eye.

premises.text: AMP4 has shown full neutralization capability of the COVID-19 virus.
premises.evidence_span: Our AMP4 shown full neutralization capability of the COVID-19 virus on lung cell culture at nanomolar level.

value.text: Antibody drugs will become affordable, accessible, and easy to use.
value.evidence_span: Our mission is to make antibody drugs as affordable, accessible, and easy to use as common pharmaceutical drugs.
